## Objective

The companion follows the run the chat works on as soon as the chat names it, lets the user browse other runs freely, and brings the user back to the chat's run automatically with the next chat turn or with one click. The panel changes of 2026-10-28 are recorded with their evidence in an AGDF run, so code, documentation and governance artefacts agree again. The companion stays opt-in, read-only, observation-only, failure-isolated and Claude-only.
